tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are hosting a movie night at your house for some friends. You want to make sure everyone is comfortable and has a good time. You need to contact your friend, Alex, who is known for having a great taste in snacks and drinks, to ask for recommendations. Write an email to Alex.
bullets: Ask for his recommendations on snacks and drinks.
Invite him to come early to help set up.
tasks.subject: Help with Movie Night Preparations
